label: What is a series
subgoals: Form partial sums S_N = sum_1^N a_n
Take N to inf for the sum

visual.title: Partial sums are the series
visual.caption: The bars are the terms and the curve is the running sum. A series is not its terms: it is the limit that curve approaches, if it approaches one.

predict.question: A series is defined as:
options: The sum of finitely many terms
The limit of its partial sums
predict.explain: The series is the limit of S_N as N grows. The lower curve in the figure is exactly the sequence of partial sums.

label: Necessary condition for convergence
subgoals: Take a_n to 0 as gate check
Reject sum (-1)^n via a_n not to 0
